$comment: v0.4 FAC-P1-08.1 classification map. A mapped test exists in the compiled suites and contains an assertion; the spec name is reported as equivalent-but-renamed, not as exact coverage.

Operation_GivenMergeAlreadyApplied_Recon.reason: The v0.4 release-integrity test seeds an applied merge, replays it, and asserts one Git merge plus reverification.

Operation_GivenDeliveryAlreadyRunning_Re.reason: A second serve over the same released work item is refused by the durable supervisor lease.

Merge_GivenApprovalAppliedBeforeRestart_.reason: A fresh runtime over the same control root refuses to apply the same approval twice.

ToolGateway_GivenToolOutsideProfile_IsDe.reason: The production dispatcher refuses a model-facing tool definition outside the pinned profile.

ToolGateway_GivenLongRunningCommand_IsTe.reason: The bounded runner terminates a long-running child at its wall-time bound under the OS job object.

Delivery_GivenStaleReleaseOnReusedPort_I.reason: The listener-ownership proof refuses a port owned by an unrelated process.

Delivery_GivenVerifiedCandidate_ReportsP.reason: A timed serve reports stopped and never claims an always-on deployment.

Lifecycle_GivenReadyForDelivery_Requires.reason: ReadyForDelivery alone does not authorize a merge; a distinct operator digest is required.

Lifecycle_GivenRealMerge_RecordsAndVerif.reason: The post-merge contract runs on the materialised merged revision and the merged SHA is recorded.

Lifecycle_GivenPostMergeContractFailure_.reason: A failed post-merge contract stays failed across restart and never records Released.

Verification_GivenHeadChangedAfterReview.reason: The theory mutates headSha among the bound fields and refuses the merge.

Verification_GivenMergeCommitDifferentFr.reason: Verification materialises the merged SHA, not the pre-merge worktree.

Supervisor_GivenRestart_UsesPinnedReleas.reason: A restarted host serves the recorded merged SHA rather than a newer target HEAD.

ToolGateway_GivenSymlinkOrJunctionEscape.reason: The physical path guard refuses a junction traversal before creating any file.

Execution_GivenTrustedEnvironmentWithout.reason: A run without applied OS bounds throws the named isolation-unavailable refusal.

Store_GivenSubmitApproveServeConcurrentP.reason: Concurrent submit, approve and dispatch are serialized under the cross-process store lock with no lost facts.

StageHandler_GivenReplayedEvent_DoesNotR.reason: A second dispatch pass claims nothing and does not duplicate the proposal.

Contract_GivenPassingGeneratedTestsButFa.reason: The operator oracle is the frozen HTTP contract; generated tests are not an acceptance input, and a wrong implementation still fails its original scenarios.
